# Presensi-QR

Presensi-QR menghasilkan kode QR dinamis untuk absensi kampus dan mencegah titip absen. Kode berganti setiap 30 detik, sehingga foto kode yang dibagikan lewat grup obrolan sudah kedaluwarsa sebelum sempat dipindai.

Proyek ini dikembangkan tim mahasiswa Laboratorium Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak Universitas Samudra Jaya sejak Februari 2026. Dalam uji coba di 4 kelas dengan total 163 mahasiswa, waktu presensi turun dari 7 menit menjadi 50 detik per sesi.

## Kebutuhan

- Node.js versi 20
- PostgreSQL 16

## Menjalankan

1. Salin `.env.example` menjadi `.env`.
2. Isi `QR_SECRET`. Aturannya: "variabel QR_SECRET wajib diisi minimal 32 karakter". Jika kurang, server tidak mau berjalan.
3. Jalankan `npm install`.
4. Jalankan `npm run dev`.

## Kontribusi

Kami menerima kontribusi dari komunitas.

## Lisensi

MIT

# Pantau-Sungai

Pantau-Sungai memantau ketinggian air sungai secara real-time dan mengirim peringatan ke grup Telegram warga saat air melewati ambang 2,5 meter. Proyek sumber terbuka ini dimulai pada Juni 2026 oleh Komunitas Maker Sungai Jeneberang Lestari bersama Karang Taruna Desa Bontosunggu Indah.

Pada banjir 18 Agustus 2026, peringatan ini memberi warga tambahan waktu evakuasi sekitar 40 menit.

## Cara kerja

- Sensor ultrasonik JSN-SR04T terpasang pada mikrokontroler ESP32 dan membaca ketinggian air setiap 60 detik.
- Data dikirim ke server lewat jaringan LoRa, dengan jangkauan maksimal 3 kilometer. Desa tanpa sinyal seluler tetap terpantau.

## Instalasi

Ikuti panduan di folder `docs`. Firmware dikompilasi dengan PlatformIO.

Many community health centers still struggle to keep accurate immunization records. Puskesmas Harapan Kita in Maros Regency serves roughly 38,000 residents and records every vaccination on paper cards kept by parents. When a card is lost, nurses have no reliable way to confirm which doses a child has already received.

A 2025 internal audit found that 1,140 children, about 14 percent of those under five, had incomplete or missing records. In the same year the center reported giving duplicate doses in 37 cases.

The head of the center has set one constraint: any new system must "work on the existing four desktop computers without new hardware purchases." This study proposes a web-based immunization registry that sends SMS reminders to parents.

In Tanjung Bira Selatan, a fishing village of 260 households, almost all catches are sold to three middlemen who set the price each morning. Interviews conducted between 5 and 19 January 2026 found that fishers receive on average 42 percent of the final retail price of red snapper.

The main reason is information. Fishers have no real-time view of prices at the Paotere Baru fish auction, 180 kilometers away. During the 2025 lean season, household incomes fell by roughly Rp 600,000 per month.

The village cooperative, Nelayan Bersatu, has stated that any solution "must be usable by fishers who only own basic feature phones." This study designs and evaluates an SMS-based price information system for the village, and asks whether a simple price broadcast could shift bargaining power.

The author interned at Lumina Cloud Solutions, a software firm headquartered on Jalan Pettarani, Makassar, from 3 June to 26 August 2026. The author joined the quality assurance team, supervised by Ms. Clara Sutanto.

The team tested a mobile banking application used by approximately 95,000 customers of Bank Sejahtera Mandala. The author's main task was writing automated test scripts in Appium, which eventually covered 212 test cases.

Before automation, a full regression cycle took the team 5 working days and often delayed releases. With the scripts in place, the same cycle took about 6 hours, and the team moved from monthly to weekly releases.

The supervisor held one rule throughout: "no build ships unless every critical test passes twice in a row."

The author completed a ten-week placement in the customer data division of the Regional Water Utility of Kota Sungai Biru. The placement began on 14 July 2026 under Mr. Arief Nugraha, the division's head of information systems.

The utility kept billing data for 48,300 household connections in a legacy spreadsheet system. Duplicate customer entries in that system caused 1,900 households to receive two bills in May 2026, and complaints followed.

The author's task was to find and merge these duplicates without losing any customer's payment history. Management had insisted that "no record may be deleted, only merged and flagged," and that rule shaped every step of the work. Using Python scripts and manual verification, the author cleaned 3,412 records over six weeks.

Completion rates in massive open online courses remain low. This study tested whether gamification raises student engagement in online programming courses. It ran at Nusantara Open Academy over a 12-week term beginning in February 2026, with 486 learners split into a control group and an experimental group that received badges, streaks, and a weekly leaderboard. The experimental group completed the course at 63 percent, against 29 percent in the control group. Activity logs suggest the gain came mainly from streak reminders, which cut the average gap between study sessions from 5.1 days to 2.3 days. The leaderboard had no measurable effect on quiz scores.

Keywords: gamification, online learning, engagement, completion rate.
